sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Hey Calvin, Veronica said you had my bag?

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: Oh Yeah! Well I did have it, but that was a while ago. Sorry.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Don't worry about it. It's full of old junk anyway.

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: Oh hey! That reminds me, Found 'sum old photos *urppp* in my house...

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: It's me and an old friend of mine...

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: That's what I looked like back in the day.

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: I don't feel like I fit in this town very much 'sumtimes... *urrp*

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: I think you fit in just right.

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: Now I do, now I do... friends help with that.

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: You think I could get past you?

sequence.speaker: Calvin
sequence.text: Don't stay out there too long a-and *Burp* Come back to visit sometime.
